rationale: Enumerated all synchronous-unit commitments; g2+g3+g4 is the lowest-share combination meeting both constraints. Inertia = (180*5.0 + 240*3.8 + 90*6.0)/1000 = 2.352 GWs gives RoCoF = 180*50/(2*2.352*1000) = 1.913 Hz/s <= 2.0. Short-circuit sum = 360+440+190 = 990 MVA gives SCR = (1180+990)/720 = 3.014 >= 2.25. Synchronous share = 510/1000 = 51%.
